name: cache-keeper
description: Keeps the prompt cache of an idle chat, or one waiting on an answer, warm with a silent ping just before it expires, and shows warm or cold above the prompt and in Switchboard

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request. 60 on a subscription, 5 in usage overage or on an API key.

idleHours.title: Stop after idle (hours)
idleHours.description: Stop pinging once the chat has sat idle this long.

waitHours.title: Stop after an open tool (hours)
waitHours.description: Stop pinging once a question or command has been open this long.
